caption: Pipeline overview for offline K1 velocity response analysis. Measurement artifacts are converted into schema-governed dataset records, used by a conservative response model, mapped into advisory navigation-risk metadata, and audited through claim governance. The figure explicitly excludes compensation, inverse command mapping, navigation control, and safe command adapter execution.
